note: Pixel measurements read from references/omega-speedmaster-moonwatch-professional-31030425001001/omega-31030425001001_original.png (1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG, upright render with a slight tilt / yaw, crown at 3 with two chronograph pushers at about +-23.5 deg, steel bracelet that runs off the image at 12 and 6 o'clock, asymmetric twisted lugs). ALL POSITIONS ARE CONTINUOUS PHOTO COORDINATES (pixel i spans [i, i+1]).
scale_basis: No circle of the silhouette is on the case (the left flank is the twisted lug), so the scale is the mean of three published dimensions read on the photo: case width 42 mm = left silhouette extreme x 247.1 to the bezel centre x 512.3 = 265.2 px -> 12.63 px/mm; lug to lug 47.5 mm = rows 163.7 (lug top where it meets the bracelet) to 768.5 (lug bottom) = 604.8 px -> 12.73 px/mm; bracelet / lug width 20 mm = 255.9 px (silhouette x 386.1 .. 642.0 at row 160) -> 12.79 px/mm; adopted 12.7 (case 41.8 mm, lug to lug 47.6 mm, bracelet 20.15 mm).
pivot_basis: least-squares point of the three hand axes (hour 304.15 deg, minute 48.48 deg, seconds 222.45 deg, edge-midpoint line fits in rotated strips, residuals 0.04 / 0.42 / 0.41 px); the hub circle sits at (512.5, 453) (base lower than the hand pivot, tilt parallax), the bezel top circle at (512.3, 452.05).
bezel_out_circle_note: black bezel ring outer edge (dark ring to steel case ring, 50 percent crossing on 1.5 deg rays, 81 points, ellipse axes 499.9 x 501.9 px = round); NOT the scale anchor (see scale_basis). The steel ring beyond it (about 15 px at 9 o'clock) and the lug flank are in the silhouette.
rings_note: radial profiles at 285 / 300 / 200 / 225 deg from (512.4, 452.0): dial print ends r 192, black dial margin to 213, lighter inner chamfer of the bezel r 214 .. 222 (grey 50 .. 75), black bezel top (numerals / ticks) r 222 .. 250.3, bright steel ring from 251. No steel coin ring on the Speedmaster bezel: insert_out = bezel_out.
right_override_note: rows where the right alpha edge is a chronograph pusher (upper rows 308..376, lower 549..617) or the crown (421..503): replaced by the straight case flank / crown-guard shoulder line; the 3D pushers and crown are added in the step
pushers_note: axis-aligned views (rotated about the origin) of the silhouette: upper pusher t -28.6 .. +30.7 (centre +1.1), end face s 301.5; lower pusher t -31 .. +30.5, end face s 302.5; the two axes do not pass through one point (tilt), so each has its own origin; top / bottom edge slopes 0.42 / 0.47 -> 23.5 deg
